title: Surya Narayana & Mithila Kalash Yatra
hindiTitle: सूर्य नारायण एवं मिथिला कलश यात्रा
description: Traditional Madhubani scroll masterpiece featuring the radiant central Sun God (Surya Narayana) surrounded by Mithila women in ritual procession carrying sacred Kalash pots adorned with Kachni borders.
verseOrStory: In ancient Mithila tradition, Surya is the supreme celestial witness of life. Women carrying holy kalash represent the sacred invocation of abundance, rain, and familial prosperity.
medium: Acrylic & Natural Pigments on Textured Handmade Sheet

title: Surya-Chandra Duality Mandala
description: Intricate Madhubani Kachni line-hatching portraying the eternal balance of Solar (vital energy, fire) and Lunar (cooling peace, water) energies enclosed in geometric tribal borders.
verseOrStory: Harmonizing the fiery solar masculine force and the tranquil lunar feminine current, this mandala invites spatial equilibrium and Vastu harmony into modern living spaces.
medium: Fine Nib Ink & Poster Colors on Archival Sheet

title: Bhavatu Sabba Mangalam (Bodhi Tree Multi-Panel Mural)
description: A monumental 5-panel spiritual mural depicting the serene Buddha in deep meditation under the golden Bodhi tree with sacred Pali chanting and Dhammapada verses 29 & 30.
verseOrStory: 'Bhavatu Sabba Mangalam, Bhavatu Sabba Mangalam. May all beings be peaceful, may all beings be free, be happy. Sadhu, Sadhu, Sadhu.' - Universal Loving Kindness (Metta).
medium: Multi-Panel Mixed Media & Calligraphy on Hand-stretched Linen

title: Buddha in Golden Sunflowers
description: Serene Buddha face dawning with gentle wisdom, enveloped by radiant orange-red sunflowers over a deep oceanic indigo background.
verseOrStory: Sunflowers constantly turn towards the light, symbolizing the mind that turns away from darkness and perpetually seeks awakening and compassion.
medium: Acrylic & Gouache on Heavyweight Art Board

title: Rejoice in Dhamma (Dhammapada Verse)
description: Profile of Buddha in golden radiating aura with pink lotus buds, adorned with sacred calligraphy from the Dhammapada.
verseOrStory: 'Here he rejoices, hereafter he rejoices, one who performed meritorious deeds rejoices in both existences. He rejoices and greatly rejoices when he sees the purity of his own deeds.' — Dhammapada Verse
medium: Fine Calligraphy Ink & Watercolors on Archival Paper

title: The Rightly-Directed Mind (Dhammapada)
description: Contemplative Buddha in Anjali mudra amidst lush green foliage and sacred golden buds with inspirational calligraphy.
verseOrStory: 'Not a mother, nor a father, nor any other relative can do more for the well-being of one than a rightly-directed mind can.' — Dhammapada
medium: Calligraphy & Acrylic Ink on Canvas Board

title: Tathagata in Abhaya Mudra
description: Tathagata seated in Padmasana blessing the universe with the Abhaya (fearlessness) gesture, framed with traditional ancient geometric border motifs.
verseOrStory: 'Vayadhamma sankhara appamadena sampadetha' (All conditioned things are subject to decay; strive diligently for liberation) — The Final Words of the Tathagata.
medium: Natural Earth Pigments & Acrylic on Hand-lined Paper

title: Vipassana: Journey from Misery to Liberation
description: Poetic silhouette of meditating Buddha in deep indigo and ascending monk bearing a lotus blossom through radiant sunflowers towards spiritual awakening.
verseOrStory: 'The only conversion involved in Vipassana is from misery to happiness, from bondage to Liberation.'

title: Buddha in Bodhi Leaf Impressions
description: Unique mixed media painting incorporating authentic Bodhi leaf impressions with crimson rose blooms cradling the peaceful face of the Buddha.
verseOrStory: Merging nature's real botanical forms with devotional art, capturing the living essence of the Bodhi tree under which enlightenment was realized.
medium: Botanical Leaf Print & Acrylic on Paper

title: Taming the Mind (Dhammapada Verse 35)
description: The blessing hand of the Buddha holding a sacred green Bodhi leaf against a vibrant ochre robe with inscribed wisdom from the Dhammapada.
verseOrStory: 'The mind is difficult to control; swiftly and lightly, it moves and lands wherever it pleases. It is good to tame the mind, for a well-tamed mind brings happiness.' — Dhammapada Verse 35. Bhavatu Sabba Mangalam.

title: Quiet Like a Broken Gong (Nibbana)
description: Buddha draped in ceremonial vermilion robes with luminous golden halo surrounded by starry jasmine flowers and hand-inked verse.
verseOrStory: 'If you can keep yourself calm and quiet like a broken gong which is no longer resonant, you are sure to realize Nibbana, there will be no harshness in you.' — Dhammapada Verse
medium: Calligraphy & Acrylic on Archival Black Sheet

title: Tathagata under the Bodhi Tree
description: Buddha in earth-touching stillness beneath the sacred branches of the Bodhi tree in deep natural contemplation.
verseOrStory: 'Vayadhamma sankhara appamadena sampadetha' — Live with awareness and mindfulness in each breath.

title: Resting Buddha in Pink Lotus
description: Youthful resting Buddha nestled peacefully inside the petals of a grand blooming pink lotus surrounded by ancient golden swirled motifs.
verseOrStory: The blooming lotus emerging spotless from muddy waters represents the purity and unshakeable peace of the awakened mind.
medium: Acrylic & Gold Dust Paint on Handmade Sheet
